Static /MT C++20 • Minimal SBOM • Air-Gap Friendly

Security, Dual-Signing & Zero-Telemetry Pledge

RaggieSoft Installer Studio is compiled directly from first-party C++20 source with cl.exe /MT and the stock Windows 11 SDK—linking only OS-resident System32 libraries with zero third-party packages, zero outbound IDE telemetry, and zero cryptocurrency/blockchain code.

Signed Binary Notice • Why Windows SmartScreen Still Prompts Temporarily

100% Cryptographically Signed: Every official RaggieSoft Studio download—including Universal Web & Offline Setup.exe launchers, inner x64 & ARM64 .msi databases, Installer Studio v0.5.0, and Accessibility Studio v1.0.0—is Dual-Layer Authenticode-signed via Microsoft Azure Artifact Signing (Verified publisher: Michael Ragsdale, RFC 3161 timestamped, and verified with signtool verify /pa).

Why SmartScreen may still say “Windows protected your PC” right now: Our Microsoft Public Trust signing certificate is brand-new (issued November 25, 2026). Under Microsoft’s current SmartScreen rules, newly issued certificates start at zero download reputation until initial install volume and Microsoft Security Intelligence (WDSI) review complete (already submitted). To install safely while reputation clears: click More info, confirm Windows shows Publisher: Michael Ragsdale (never “Unknown publisher”), and click Run anyway. Full details in the FAQ →

Four Pillars of Clean Engineering

1. Static /MT Compilation & Minimal SBOM

No NuGet dependency graph, no npm runtime, no Chromium bundle, and no external DLLs—even RaggieSoftHelp.exe renders offline topics natively via System32\Msftedit.dll.

2. Dual-Layer Authenticode & Azure Artifact Signing

When [Signing] Enabled = true (or RSW_SIGN_ENABLED=1), instbuild.exe signs the inner Product.msi first, strips any template certificate table cleanly via ImageRemoveCertificate, embeds the signed database into Setup.exe via UpdateResourceW, and signs the outer executable—automatically matching x64/ARM64 signtool.exe to Azure.CodeSigning.Dlib.dll.

3. Prism-Piercing OS & Silicon Verification

Calls RtlGetVersion inside ntdll.dll (bypassing GetVersionEx manifest shims) and IsWow64Process2 to detect true ARM64 vs. x64 silicon even under Windows 11 Prism emulation, plus SHA-256 bcrypt.dll payload verification.

4. Permanent Zero-Telemetry & Zero-Crypto Pledge

Neither InstallerStudio.exe, instbuild.exe, msiprism.exe, nor RaggieSoftHelp.exe phones home to a license server or bundles cryptocurrency payment SDKs.
